more_info.overview: Ferrous lactate is an iron(II) salt of lactic acid used for colour retention in specified foods. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties. EU permissions include fruit and vegetables in vinegar oil or brine, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain fruit and vegetables in vinegar, oil, or brine; canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
